The Brackenhide gnolls are a clan native to the Azure Span on the Dragon Isles. During the war against the Primalists, they had embraced decay magic and posed a serious threat to the Azure Span and its inhabitants.

Brawl Star is a world event achievement earned by completing all Brawler's Guild Challenge Broker Gambits. Earning the achievement also awards the title. Speak with at Bizmo's Brawlpub or at Brawl'gar Arena. When asked, the challenge broker says:

Brawler's Chilled is a world event achievement earned during the season of the Brawler's Guild by opting into the challenge gambit with at Bizmo's Brawlpub or at Brawl'gar Arena. This is one of the criteria of Brawl Star. With this gambit, standard ice physics apply to the arena and players will slip and slide around.

Brawlzilla is a world event achievement earned during the season of the Brawler's Guild by opting into the challenge gambit with at Bizmo's Brawlpub or at Brawl'gar Arena. This is one of the criteria of Brawl Star. With this gambit, players are vastly increased in size and have their run speed reduced to compensate.
Brawler's Fight Tonic of Strength is available for from vendors at Brawler's Guilds at Bizmo's Brawlpub or the Brawl'gar Arena during the season.

The Brew Defender Ball would be used with the Brew Defender in the Unga Ingoo scenario. It reuses the use-effect from the Magic Bamboo Shoot.

Brew Bay is the lobby and waiting room of Plunderstorm. Captain Keg Leg and Keg Leg's Crew have set up here in an attempt to gather plunder. The bay is located where the Arathi coast dwarven farm would be in non-Plunderstorm realms on the southeastern shore of the Arathi Highlands. The area also serves as a training room, letting players interact with mechanics, loot chests to acquire spells, and practice combat/revival in the untimed Practice mode, or briefly before the match begins.

Bridge to Nowhere begins the optional "Of Boughs and Bonds" chapter of the Ghosts of K'aresh campaign alongside Clearing the Dunes. Find Om'fennad at Hosaas' Rest on the south shore of the western island of K'aresh to begin. This chapter rewards Explorer 1 belts and +500 reputation with the K'aresh Trust.

Bright Linen Bolt is a cloth bolt crafting reagent made with and used in Midnight Tailoring. The ability to make this item is automatically learned after learning Midnight Tailoring. The following items are crafted with Midnight Tailoring using Bright Linen Bolts:
Brimstone Lavamaws are hell hounds found in Island Expeditions.

Brightwing Estate is an area located along the northeastern coast of Eversong Woods. It is the home of Ranger-General Halduron Brightwing, who respectively renovated the spire and grounds formerly owned by Magister Duskwither into his personal abode and a conservation for Eversong's wildlife. lynxes, dragonhawks, hawkstriders, unicorns, and mana wyrms roam the grounds, tended to by the conservators. In addition to the conservation staff, Brightwing's efforts are supported by the Farstriders of the Silvermoon Court. The ranger-general himself apparently raises butterflies on the grounds.
Brightsparkle is a faerie found fighting Lady Moonberry at the Heart of the Forest in Ardenweald during Drust and Ashes.
Bristletooth Maulers are dead bears found at the Mountainview Post on the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Bronze is the currency used in Pandaria Remix and is acquired from enemies, quest rewards, and scrapping unwanted or outleveled items with the Unraveling Sands during the event. They can also be collected by simply flying through Bronze motes out in the world. Additionally, achievements award bronze caches, which contain varying amount of Bronze: *Cache of Infinite Treasure *Minor Bronze Cache (250) *Lesser Bronze Cache (500) *Bronze Cache (750) *Greater Bronze Cache (1250) Bronze can be traded for collectibles, mounts, and appearances at Infinite Bazaars across Pandaria.

Bronze Breath is an ability used by Ageless Bronze Drake during a Pet Battle.

The Bronze Enclave is located on the eastern side of Valdrakken. The area is mostly inhabited by members of the bronze dragonflight and features their motifs, including a large hourglass and an abundance of sand. The Parting Glass is an inn located on the southern, lower level of the enclave. The Engine of Innovation is east of The Parting Glass. Aurastil and her corgi companion Rex occasionally patrol this area.
Brown Dragon Turtles are dragon turtles located at the pandaren camps in Orgrimmar and Stormwind City.
Bronze Rewind is available when Bronze Timelock has been used to place a portal. It can be used to teleport back to this portal.
The Broodling of Sinestra is a twilight drake mount that can be purchased for 5,000 from Kiatke in Stormwind City or Orgrimmar during Cataclysm timewalking events.

Brother Cloudbluff is a grummle located in any neighborhood where Friend of the Grummles is the active endeavor. He appears at the grummles' southern base camp in the Bloom in Razorwind Shores. Giving him 5 will apply , allowing you to climb the rock wall next to him up to the kafa'kota berry garden. The garden can also be accessed by flying mount.
Broodmother Valraxx is a spider found in the Mountain Den in .

Bruxie Slyhook is a goblin located at the G.E.T.A. Headquarters in the Undermine. As the lead G.E.T.A. officer, she hired adventurers to deal with a number of local beasts that were causing trouble in the city. These jobs included hunting down a radioactive rat that was chased into a nearby sewer and was highly aggressive. A crocodile that was released by its owner after it got too big and started eating goblins. And a skipper, called the Captain, who was organizing a band of skippers that had gotten into the Undermine sewers and were starting to populate, causing all sorts of problems.
Bubble Blast is an ability used by various companions during a Pet Battle.

Brutal Gladiator: Season 4 is a feat of strength earned for ending PvP Season 4 in the top 0.1% of the arena ladder with at least 50 games won. The achievement is automatically earned by those that had obtained the :Brutal Gladiator title during Season 4. The title is also rewarded by the achievement for those that do qualify but happened to have lost the title.
Brutal Strike is an ability card from the Crown of the Heavens set.
Brutal Steel is an ability card from the Betrayal of the Guardian set.

Buckled Up is an account-wide feat of strength for acquiring 50,000 Plunder in Plunderstorm matches. The total amount collected is visible on the Plunderstorm character select screen, and during matches in the menu in the upper right. On retail realms, the tracking macro below will link the achievement and display the current total: /run local c,_,_,_,a,b=BreakUpLargeNumbers,GetAchievementCriteriaInfo(20509,1) print(GetAchievementLink(20509),c(a),"of",c(b),C_CurrencyInfo.GetCurrencyLink(2922))

Buckler of the Last Stand is looted from an Ethereal Voidforged Container atop a broken wall in the Ruins of Yaathron while Phase Diving in K'aresh. If the appearance of this item is already known, Shattered Buckler of the Last Stand will appear in its place.
Burning Felhounds are felhounds summoned by Scarshield Warlocks in Hordemar City in Lower Blackrock Spire.
Burning Cleave is an ability used by a Demonology warlock's Demonic Tyrant, when talented into Antoran Armaments.
Burning Emberguards are unbound fire elementals found in Island Expeditions.
Burning Ones is a shop run by Venom Dahn in the Burrows in the City of Threads.
Burning Roots are found as part of Dreamsurge portal events on the Dragon Isles. They can be destroyed for 1% progress towards stage 1 of the events.
Burning Winds is a Shaman ability card from the Twilight of the Dragons set.

Burnt Ransom Note wass posted on Alyx's call board on 12 November. It reads: On Mount Hyjal in the Whistling Grove after unlocking the Firelands Invasion, Mylune asks players to save some stranded Hyjal Bear Cubs by chucking them from the tops of trees to a Soft Target in the form of a trampoline. This is perfectly safe, the Those Bears Up There daily quest assures us. The Charred Celebration Crate is at at the base of the trampoline. The fastest way there is the portal to Mount Hyjal from the Eastern and Western Earthshrines in Orgrimmar and Stormwind City. C.H.E.T.T. or Concierge. Honored Employee, and Transaction Terminal is a machine located in the Incontinental Hotel in the Undermine. Once a week at Renown 13 with the Cartels of Undermine, it hands over a C.H.E.T.T. List, tasking players with completing a few small tasks for Valorstones. Turn in a list for 250 Valorstones. After turning in two lists, further turn-ins can take place at cartel quartermasters for +250 reputation with that faction if players don't need the Valorstones.
Burrower's Cinch drops from Anub'zekt in Ara-Kara, City of Echoes.
CHUCK-135 is a mechanical dog located between Grit Alphadrill and Lathe Faceter upstairs at the Incontinental Hotel during the Liberation of Undermine. It can be petted.

Busted Rune Dispenser is found at the Incontinental Hotel in the Liberation of Undermine after reaching Renown Rank 2 with the Gallagio Loyalty Rewards Club. It has a chance to give the Crystallized Augment Rune.

C.H.E.T.T. List is provided by the C.H.E.T.T. on the upper floor of the Incontinental Hotel in Undermine after completing C.H.E.T.T.ing In at Renown 13 with the Cartels of Undermine. Additional lists can be acquired each week from C.H.E.T.T., and by turning in 40x C.H.E.T.T. Card looted from the corpses of enemies in Undermine and Sidestreet Sluice, then turning them in to C.H.E.T.T.. After turning in two lists and getting the C.H.E.T.T.ing it Twice achievement, further completed lists can be turned into the weekly allied cartel's quartermaster for reputation with that cartel instead of valorstones by trading it for a Finder's Fee. C.H.E.T.T. Cards and lists can be grinded out indefinitely.

C.H.E.T.T. a Look is the first of three achievements in a series involved with turning in a C.H.E.T.T. List to C.H.E.T.T. in the upper floor of the Incontinental Hotel in Undermine, first made available at Renown 13 with the Cartels of Undermine. Each character acquires a list from C.H.E.T.T. once per week, though more can be acquired by turning in forty found C.H.E.T.T. Cards.

C.H.E.T.T. a Look is the second of three achievements in a series involved with turning in a C.H.E.T.T. List#Completed to C.H.E.T.T. in the upper floor of the Incontinental Hotel in Undermine, first made available at Renown 13 with the Cartels of Undermine. Each character acquires a list from C.H.E.T.T. once per week, though more can be acquired by turning in forty found C.H.E.T.T. Cards. After earning this achievement, lists can be turned in to cartel quartermasters instead of C.H.E.T.T. and will receive a Finder's Fee for reputation instead of Valorstones.

Cackling Stitchsurgeons are members of the House of Constructs located in the Temple of Courage in Bastion. They can be seen on top of Flayedwing Wraiths flying above the temple.
Cacophonous Chain Shoulderguards are crafted with Leatherworking (250); learned from speaking with the Shadowy Figure in Moonglade after completing Waking the Nightmare.

Call Galefeather is a Utility ability in Plunderstorm. The galefeather lasts for 12 seconds.
Caladbolg is obtained by allowing Caladboulder to reach 0 durability.
Call Lightning X is an ability used by a pet during a Pet Battle.

Camouflaged Aqirite is a mining node variation of :Aqirite found throughout the Isle of Dorn and Ringing Deeps. A Phial of Truesight is required to see these special veins. Overload Empowered Deposit cannot be used on them.
Calm Gurd is an ottuk located with Ruft and Puft on Longclaw Island in the Azure Span.

Callum Ashvow is an Arathi located at Sun's Reach Sanctum on the Isle of Quel'Danas during the assault by the Devouring Host. Together with Commander Koruth Mountainfist and Knight Anais, he is holding the bridge leading south-west.

Captured Proto-Drake are proto-dragons located at the Wild Preserve in the Waking Shores. They are being held captive by Primalists who are attempting to corrupt them. After being freed, they fly away and despawn shortly after.

Captured Starlight is an optional crafting reagent made with Khaz Algar Jewelcrafting. The ability to make this item is taught by Design: Captured Starlight (15), which can be purchased from Lyrendal in Dornogal for 150 Artisan's Acuity.
Captured Wildhammer Dwarves were Wildhammer dwarves located near Grim Batol in the Twilight Highlands. They are held by Magic Shackles during Wildhammer and Free.

The Captured Gnarldin is a gnarldin located in the basement of a building on the west side of Silvermoon Harbor in Eversong Woods. He was imprisoned in a Bloodsworn Cage by Astalor Bloodsworn for the purpose of studying anguish.
Carefree Dragonhawks are dragonhawks that can be seen flying around at the Brightwing Estate in Eversong Woods.
Caretaker Hulmes is a nerubian skitterling located in the Little Strings in the City of Threads in Azj-Kahet.

Carved of the Undermine is a feat of strength earned by outgrowing the use of the Carved Undermine Crest during The War Within Season 2. This requires reaching an item level of 645 or higher in all equipment slots. Once done, players can trade their Carved crests up to Runed Undermine Crests in a 3-to-1 ratio by speaking with Vaskarn. The macro below will display slots that are below the required item level: /run local n=tInvert(Enum.ItemRedundancySlot),a;for i=0,16 do a = C_ItemUpgrade.GetHighWatermarkForSlot(i); if a Upon earning the achievement, Vaskarn sends players the following in-game mail attached with a Crimson Valorstone, containing 100 Valorstones.

Cashing the Check concludes the Homecoming chapter of the Undermine(d) campaign, and thus rewards the Undermined (achievement) quest achievement. After the first character on the account completes this quest, alts can opt to skip the campaign by speaking with Monte Gazlowe at the Incontinental Hotel.

Carved of the Ethereal is a feat of strength earned by outgrowing the use of Carved Ethereal Crests during The War Within Season 3. This requires reaching an item level of 131 (was 691) or higher in all equipment slots. Once done, players can trade their Carved crests up to Runed Ethereal Crests in a 3-to-1 ratio by speaking with Vaskarn. The macro below will display slots that are below the required item level: /run local n=tInvert(Enum.ItemRedundancySlot),a;for i=0,16 do a = C_ItemUpgrade.GetHighWatermarkForSlot(i); if a Upon earning the achievement, Vaskarn sends players the following in-game mail attached with a Crimson Valorstone, containing 100 Valorstones.

Cartel Om is one of the broker cartels. The dream of the cartel is intrinsically linked with the K'aresh Trust, as they seek to restore K'aresh. They act as one of the primary caretakers of Project Eco-Dome and can be found at all of the eco-domes on K'aresh. They are led by Ve'nari, having flocked to her guidance after it was evident that her vision was the strongest for the future of their people, despite other brokers attempting to kill her. Unlike the other cartels, most of their duties to the Trust are relegated outside of Tazavesh. Those who are located within the city are either largely handling matters of the Trust itself or are trading in resources found on K'aresh itself. The excep
Carpnado is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Carved Messenger are stone fiends found flying in groups of three at the Banewood in Revendreth. After reaching the end of their path, they will despawn.
Carved Taunters are stone fiends found flying underneath the gate at at the Ember Ward in Revendreth.

Cassock of Lunar Communion is part of the tier 31 priest set and can be obtained in a few different ways: *Venerated Verdurous Dreamheart, which drops from Nymue in Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope *Theozhaklos the Curious the Emerald Dream for *Kirasztia in the Emerald Dream for Flame-Warped Curio *Converting another Dragonflight Season 3 chestpiece at the Revival Catalyst Console in Thaldraszus

Credits for World of Warcraft: Cataclysm. This list is based on the in-game credits, viewable from the main menu. Minor formatting changes have been made for readability, such as replacing commas in some entries (e.g. "Dane A. Davis, MPSE") with parentheses. __TOC__

Cataclysmic Converter is a crafting reagent used by engineers to craft the Crowd Pummeler 2-30. They are sold by Paxton Bombshell at Opportunity Point in the Ringing Deeps for each. 50 Cataclysmic Converters are need to build the mount, for a total cost of . Cataclysmic Converter can also drop from the Pilfer Through Parts ability, but they seem to be an uncommon drop.

Castigaar is an area in K'aresh that serves as the sanctuary for the Wastelanders from the ravenous beasts of the Void that stalk the wastes of K'aresh. Little is known of the original use for the place. In order to survive the harsh conditions of their shattered world, the Wastelanders have set up an area for capturing and training warp stalkers at the southern end of Castigaar. In the same region are pylons set up for the Wastelanders to gather energy which they collect and store in various boxes around the camp.
Cataclysm Overseers are terrorguards that can be found at Invasion Point: Cataclysm in Shadowmoon Valley.
Catacomb Rats are rats located in Candle Rock in Highmountain.
Catacomb Gazecrawlers are basilisks found inside Candle Rock in Highmountain.
Cataclysmic Lumberjack is a housing achievement earned by collecting 250 Ashwood Lumber. This achievement unlocks the ability to gather Ashwood Lumber without dismounting.
Cataclysmic Gladiator: Season 11 is a feat of strength earned for ending PvP Season 11 in the top 0.1% of the arena ladder with at least 50 games won.
Cataclysm Milling is a Milling ability granted to scribes with Cataclysm proficiency Inscription. It is automatically added upon learning Cataclysm Inscription.
Cataclysm Prospecting is the :prospecting ability for Cataclysm Jewelcrafting. It is automatically learned upon learning Cataclysm Jewelcrafting.
Caustic Alchemical Supplies is located in the Laboratory of the Grand Splicer of the City of Threads in Azj-Kahet.
Caustic Chemicals are located in First Ascended's Prison of the City of Threads in Azj-Kahet.

Caverns of Time Portal-Keepers are found outside the Caverns of Time in Tanaris during the Bronze Celebration, holding portals to areas with Chests of Props on Azeroth and beyond, as well as portals back to the Caverns of Time. Ceaseless Swarmgland drops from Anub'zekt in Ara-Kara, City of Echoes.

Cavernous Critter Shooter drops from the following rare mobs in Khaz Algar: *Croakit *Lytfang the Lost *Matriarch Charfuria *Plaguehart *Pride of Beledar *The One Left *The Perchfather *Strength of Beledar *Zilthara
Cavemoss Clackers are makrura found at the Shipwreck Cove and initially inside Murkloc Cave in Highmountain.
Cenarion Gaurdian's Stave is sold by Cupri in Shattrath City for .
Aura of Zealotry is an Offensive ability in Plunderstorm. It lasts for 8 seconds.

The Celestial Dungeons is an optional difficulty tier for dungeons that can be queued up through the Dungeon Finder, requiring a minimum item level of 435 (the same as Heroic dungeons). It is a culmination of the Titan Rune Dungeons and the Elemental Rune Dungeons. In this difficulty, enemies throughout the dungeon will have increased health and damage and are infused with occasional raid-level mechanics and enemies, including appearances from bosses of the current raid tier. Players will commune with the August Celestials which allows them to gain powerful blessings to overcome the challenges in this difficulty tier. Celestial Carver is a PvP power that can be obtained from a Ethereal Tool Rack in the Slayer's Rise. It provides "low gravity" during the Ethereal Disruption PvP event.
Cha'lat's Sacrificial Altar is found on the Isle of Thunder and it needs to be destroyed as part of the daily Heinous Sacrifice. Spiritbinder Cha'lat can be found near it.

Chains of Shadows are a number of draenei ghosts that appear alongside Karsius the Ancient Watcher during Teron Gorefiend, I am... to subdue Teron Gorefiend at the Altar of Shadows in Shadowmoon Valley. During the battle, they collectively and periodically deal damage to Gorefiend by casting Enforced Submission. They disappear when Karsius is defeated.

Challenge Broker Senna is a pandaren located at the northeast corner of Bizmo's Brawlpub of the Deeprun Tram during the season of Brawler's Guild. Her Horde counterpart is Challenge Broker Guo. She opts players into challenge gambits, each of which awards an achievement. Complete all eight to earn Brawl Star.

Challenge Broker Guo is a pandaren located in Brawl'gar Arena during the season of Brawler's Guild. His Alliance counterpart is Challenge Broker Senna. He opts players into challenge gambits, each of which awards an achievement. Complete all eight to earn Brawl Star.

Chaincloak of the Damned Necrolyte can be obtained by converting another Midnight Season 2 cloak using the Catalyst. It is part of the Damned Necrolyte's Shattered Restraints set but is not required to benefit from the tier bonus.

The Chamber of the Air is a special meeting room of the Council of Six, the ruling council of the Kirin Tor. It has no visible walls, the gray stone floor with its central diamond symbol stood beneath an open sky that shifted and changed rapidly, as if the time sped past within the chamber. During those meeting, each member of the Six hide their identities and even their genders with magic. But the room has a hidden truth - it is actually a plain chamber enchanted with a simple parlor trick, a way to fool and amaze visitors. The Six delighted in the confusion, making sure no one entered or exited the chamber without being bewildered as to where they had been and whom they had seen and often

Chillbot 9000 is a robot companion that can be purchased at the Trading Post for 250 Trader's Tender. Chrome King Gallywix is the eighth and final boss of Liberation of Undermine. Players are tasked with defeating him in Liberation of Undermine: The House Loses, part of the final chapter of the Undermine(d) campaign. As Gallywix's defeat is required by the story, Story Mode is available for this encounter. Speak with Paks Topskimmer at the Incontinental Hotel in Undermine to begin.

Class mounts are unique mounts restricted to specific classes. Originally, class mounts were only available to paladins and warlocks. Druids received Flight Form in and +100%-speed Travel Form in ; death knights and demon hunters had mounts added alongside them; and in patch 7.2.0, all classes received new mounts with the final chapter of their Order Hall Campaigns.
Circling Somnowls are somnowls found flying above the Haven Cascades in the Emerald Dream.

Claryssa Paller is an Arathi located with her family in Dunelle's Kindness in Hallowfall. When Hallowfall once again came under threat by the Sureki and the army was stretched thin, a call to arms was issued to those with the strength to wield a weapon. Claryssa answered the call, joining the Flame's Radiance. She was stationed at Lothar's Landing, where he could be seen healing wounded soldiers.

Classic Milling is a Milling ability granted to scribes with Classic proficiency Inscription. It is automatically added upon learning Classic Inscription.

City-states are autonomous cities that exercise sovereign authority over itself and its immediate territories, maintaining its own government, military, laws, diplomacy, and economy independent of any larger nation.

City of the Dead is the first act of the Undead Campaign, Forsaken Kingdom, in Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom. The following act is A Scarlet Flame.

Claws of Tainted Ichor drop from Ki'katal the Harvester in Ara-Kara, City of Echoes.

Coagulated Azerites are Azerite oozelings found in Island Expeditions.
Cloudburst is an ability card from the Betrayal of the Guardian set.

Cogwalkers are small quadrupedal robots with a small turret on the front and a shell-like head. These types of robots have commonly been utilized by gnomes and earthen so far. Some models are capable of flight and small fire attacks. They are used for a myriad of purposes such as eradicating bugs, recording and projecting audible holograms, long-distance communication, taking photos, scouting, and surveillance.

The Coiled Isle is an island located east of Zul'Aman, connected via the ruined Strait of Hexx'alor and surrounded by the Zul'Aman Depths. It is shrouded in a mist. The temple here, Atal'Utek, was built to commemorate the Amani tribes' victory over the faceless general Kith'ix. The strait dividing the Coiled Isle from Zul'Aman is protected by the loa Pahk. Venom seeping from Atal'Utek into the surrounding waters has warped the ecology of the isle chain. <!-- ==History==
Coastal Fathomjaws are threshadons found in Island Expeditions.

The Collection: Wings of Awakening is an ensemble of dragon wings available in five color variants that represents each primary dragonflight.
